Job Description: Essentia Health is seeking a dynamic leader to serve as Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment. In this role, you will guide strategy, lead a high-performing team, and partner with senior leaders to ensure Essentia attracts and retains top physician and advanced practice talent.

Education Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is required.
  • A master’s degree (e.g., MBA, MHA) is preferred.
  • Professional certification in HR or talent acquisition (e.g., SHRM-SCP, SPHR, AAPPR) is a plus.

About the Role: Director, Physician and Provider Recruitment

The Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment will be a strategic and transformational leader. Reporting to the Senior Director of Physician and Professional Services, and as a member of the office of Chief Medical Officer, this leader will not only manage the full-cycle recruitment of physicians and advanced practice professionals (APPs) but will also serve as a trusted business partner to Essentia Health's senior leadership and clinical teams. The ideal candidate will leverage data and market intelligence to drive proactive workforce planning, enhance the provider experience, and ensure Essentia Health attracts and retains top-tier clinical talent.

The Opportunity: Evolving to a Talent Advisory Model

Essentia Health seeks an innovative and results-oriented Director of Physician and Provider Recruitment to lead a pivotal transformation of its talent acquisition function. This is more than a recruitment leadership role; it is an opportunity to redefine how Essentia Health finds, attracts, and integrates clinical talent. The Director will be a change agent, building a team and a strategy that proactively supports Essentia's growth, strategic goals, and commitment to patient care.

As a talent advisor , the Director will:

  • Move Beyond Transactional Recruitment: Shift the team to become a strategic partner in workforce planning. This involves anticipating future talent needs, identifying market trends, and advising clinical and operational leaders on talent strategies that align with business objectives.
  • Leverage Market Intelligence: Use data, analytics, and competitive market insights to inform decisions. The Director will develop robust dashboards to track key performance indicators (KPIs) like time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, and retention rates, providing transparent and actionable insights to leadership.
  • Build a Proactive Pipeline: Transition to a highly proactive approach, building and nurturing a continuous pipeline of qualified candidates. This includes strengthening relationships with residency programs, fellowship directors, and professional associations, as well as optimizing digital and direct-sourcing strategies.
  • Enhance the Candidate and Provider Experience: Champion a seamless, professional, and personalized candidate journey from initial contact through onboarding. This includes collaborating with HR, Credentialing, and Legal teams to streamline processes and ensure a positive, welcoming experience for new providers.
  • Develop the Team's Capabilities: Mentor and coach the recruitment team to evolve, develop, and grow in their profession. This will involve equipping them with capabilities that include consulting with stakeholders, interpreting market data, and effectively managing relationships to drive better outcomes.
  • Serve as a Strategic Business Driver: Demonstrate the direct impact of the recruitment function on Essentia Health's strategic priorities, including financial performance, patient access, and clinical quality. This involves articulating the value of talent acquisition as a core business function rather than a support service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute a comprehensive recruitment strategy for physicians and APPs that is fully integrated with Essentia's workforce planning and growth goals.
  • Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop the provider recruitment team, fostering a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Build and maintain strong, credible relationships with executive and clinical leadership, serving as a trusted advisor on all talent-related matters.
  • Operational Excellence: Oversee all aspects of the full-cycle recruitment process, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and best-in-class candidate experience.
  • Performance Analytics: Utilize metrics and dashboards to monitor recruitment effectiveness and provide regular, data-driven updates to senior leadership.
  • Brand Ambassador: Represent Essentia Health at key recruitment events and professional forums to enhance the organization's provider brand and network.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with HR, Provider Compensation, Legal, and other departments to streamline processes and ensure a coordinated approach to provider engagement and retention.

Required Experience and Knowledge

  • Progressive Leadership: A minimum of eight years of experience in healthcare, talent acquisition, or provider recruitment, with at least three to five years in a leadership role responsible for team management, resource allocation, and financial oversight.
  • Strategic Acumen: Demonstrated success in designing and executing recruitment strategies that align with broader organizational goals.
  • Data-Driven Mindset: Proven ability to leverage data, analytics, and market intelligence to drive decisions and improve recruitment performance.
  • Operational Expertise: Strong knowledge of full-cycle recruitment processes, including sourcing, interviewing, contracting, and onboarding, within a complex healthcare environment.
  • Compliance and Regulation: A solid understanding of employment law, credentialing, and the unique dynamics of the provider workforce.
  • Relationship Builder: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a track record of building trusted partnerships with executive leaders, physicians, and staff.

description:
Principal Software Engineer

We’re currently hiring a Principal Software Engineer to join our growing remote team.


Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we’re transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we’re investing in the next generation of our platform—and we’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help drive it.

See what we’re building

Why This Role Rocks

  • Own What You Build – Lead projects end-to-end with full autonomy and real impact.
  • Remote & Flexible – Work from anywhere and set your own hours.

  • Join at the Right Time – We have strong product-market fit and real momentum—you’ll help define what comes next.

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages & Frameworks: PHP (Laravel), JavaScript (React, React Native, Vue)
  • Cloud Services: AWS (Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora, Redshift)
  • Approach: We’re not fixated on specific languages. If you have strong engineering fundamentals and experience with any mainstream object-oriented language, we believe you can quickly learn and adapt to our tech stack.

What You’ll Do

As a Principal Software Engineer , you’ll work closely with the Software Architect and other engineers to:

  • Collaborate on designing and implementing system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards.
  • Lead technical initiatives across teams, ensuring alignment with architectural direction and goals.
  • Build and maintain platform-level components , services, and libraries that enhance engineering efficiency and system maintainability.
  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on guidance.
  • Contribute directly to both server-side and client-side development across the entire stack.
  • Write and review technical design documents , system diagrams, and reference implementations.
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve our platform.
  • Enhance observability, performance, scalability, and security throughout our system.
  • Share knowledge and insights to foster team growth and improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • We’re looking for someone who is:
    • Experienced:
      • A principal engineer, lead full-stack engineer, or someone with relevant experience in similar roles.
      • Highly skilled in both server-side and client-side software development.
    • Technically Proficient:
      • Familiar with cloud development (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure).
      • Experienced with Test Driven Development (TDD) , RESTful APIs , React , MVC frameworks , and security concerns (e.g., XSS attacks).
    • Fundamentally Strong in Computer Science Concepts:
      • You can explain concepts like Big O notation , pointers , composition vs. inheritance , and data structures such as arrays, sets, and linked lists .
    • Database-Savvy:
      • Proficient in SQL and NoSQL databases, and understand operations like CRUD , indexes , and joins .
    • Cloud Infrastructure Expert:
      • Comfortable working with cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS Lambda, ECS, EKS, Aurora ) and utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IAC) .
    • Customer-Centric:
      • Passionate about clean code and building customer-driven solutions with a focus on quality and reliability.

All team members at LawnStater are expected to embody our core values which are: Be data-driven, Get shit done, People are critical, Challenge the status quo, Be scrappy, and Be the Customer.

Salary Range : 130K-180K USD annually

Healthcare benefits: Medical, dental, and vision

Fully remote position: Work remotely from anywhere you want.

Unlimited PTO: We focus on results. Take the time you need to recharge or enjoy life, work hard when you are back.

Descrição da função

Principais responsabilidades

Gerenciamento de Categorias e Implantação de Sourcing Estratégico

  • Desenvolver parcerias de negócios robustas e conduza o gerenciamento das partes interessadas para atender às necessidades de negócios de forma adequada.

Atividades operacionais

  • Gerenciar atividades de compras de categoria regional e local, incluindo gerenciamento de demanda e experiência de compra.

Gestão de Demanda

  • Elaboração de um plano de demanda alinhado com o negócio e a estratégia da categoria
  • Construir um projeto sólido e um pipeline de economia durante o ciclo orçamentário e mantê-lo ao longo do ano
  • Desafiar construtivamente a demanda e moldá-la para agregar o máximo valor aos nossos negócios.

Source-to-Pay (experiência de compra)

  • Projetar e executar um processo de licitação competitivo para o projeto da categoria para obter as melhores soluções gerais de valor agregado dos fornecedores candidatos.

  • Oferecer economia e redução de custos e rastreá-las em um sistema de relatórios para garantir que as economias negociadas sejam transformadas em economias realizadas e reais.

  • Promover a cultura de Ética e Integridade nos Negócios em sua equipe servindo como um modelo ao garantir adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi em relação à equipe que gerencia, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária (Road Safety), com objetivo de prevenir acidentes, evitar riscos para a saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir os impactos ambientais resultantes da execução de suas atividades laborais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão da Sanofi para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais.

Sobre você

  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing que possa desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; Forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (Request for Information / Proposal / Quotation); Histórico comprovado na liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas importantes; Forte compreensão de contratos legais, incluindo acordos de nível de serviço, acordos de preço fixo ou fórmula para materiais diretos; Experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); Trabalho em equipe com excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de networking e comunicação; Conhecimento e experiência na gestão de projetos e contratos locais; Conhecimento intermediário de Finanças e Análise de Custos.

  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.

Por que nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. Acreditamos na eficácia de produzir medicamentos genéricos com qualidade e rigor científico para o bem da saúde.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes e serviços de apoio. A Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Na Sanofi, oferecemos as mesmas oportunidades a todos, sem discriminação por raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Unreal Game Engineer)
description:
Overview

As a Senior Software Development Engineer focused on Unreal gameplay programming, you\'ll continue to grow your expertise in writing high-quality code while learning and using a breadth of skills to make a game awesome for players. We are prepared to craft the role around the right person, whether you\'ve been programming for 4 years or 20. Teaching others first and maintaining a mentorship culture are key ingredients to our success.

Gamebreaking Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity, and are committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for our team.

Desired Skills & Qualifications

  • A passion for games and entertainment that shows. Whether you love video games, board games, cosplay, or freeze tag — we want to know! If it doesn\'t shine through your resume (e.g. work, academic, or community experience), please submit a cover letter
  • 5+ years of professional game programming experience
  • Experience working in a large, established code base
  • Deep knowledge of C++ programming and best practices
  • Flexibility and desire to work on a variety of game systems
  • Experience developing with Unreal Engine 4/5 is a plus

Your Responsibilities

  • Write code that is clear, well-tested and modular.
  • Architect features and services with a mind towards operability and scalability.
  • Assist game teams with technology choices and follow through with implementation.
  • Mentor more junior engineers via paired programming and code reviews.
  • Work with project managers inside and outside our studio to deliver features to players.

Our Responsibilities To You

  • Encourage healthy working hours, PTO, and a respect for your time.
  • Foster an environment of equal opportunity, treatment, and inclusion.
  • Create a fun and playful environment that remains professional and respectful.
  • Grow our culture positively and meaningfully through a high level of transparency and thoughtful conversation.
  • Provide opportunities for you to learn and grow.

Potential Roles and Growth Paths

  • Tech Lead — Lead a tech team through mentorship, setting code standards, and designing and building systems.
  • Engineering Lead — Hire, manage, and mentor a small group of engineers while maintaining client relationships and code familiarity.
  • Tech Area Expert — Apply subject-matter expertise as a solo strike team focused on solving tech issues, advising client teams, and designing systems in your domain.
  • DIY — A small company means big opportunities if you\'re willing to forge your path, and we\'re here to support you!
  • Full Health Benefits — Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Open PTO
  • Fully Remote Work
  • Annual Company Retreat

About Gamebreaking

Gamebreaking Studios is a young, growing, LA-based company founded by technology leaders from around games, entertainment, and software. We found early success providing work-for-hire to other studios and now build everything from end-to-end games to online game platforms to individual feature integrations. We also develop our own games and IP alongside other projects.

Our mission: We aspire to make games and media so fun that it improves people\'s relationships and behaviors. That is to say, while we are not a "serious games" company, we believe that making fun-first games enables us to have a positive impact. We believe deeply in our core values and hope to find people who share them:

  • Take Responsibility
  • Raise The Tide, Not One Boat
  • Ambitious Goals, Disciplined Execution
  • Design For People, Own Your Craft
  • We Play Together

For folks living and working outside the US

This position is open to candidates living and working throughout most of Latin America. Applicants must be fluent in English, willing to work according to US time zones (must be available 8am - 3pm Pacific Time), and have a strong, stable internet connection conducive to remote work and video calls. Outside the US, we work with an Employer of Record (deel.com) to hire full-time employees. This works very similar to how employees would work for a company based in their home country. Note that work authorization in the country you will work from is still required.

Descrição da função

Nosso compromisso é garantir que fornecemos produtos e serviços de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades dos pacientes e operar em conformidade com todos os regulamentos aplicáveis ao longo de seu ciclo de vida.

Nossa Ambição de Qualidade é transformar o modelo operacional em um modelo mais dinâmico, de alto desempenho e orientado por dados, permitindo a transformação de nossa empresa.

Junte-se à nossa equipe de Sistemas da Qualidade para garantir que os produtos sejam fabricados, testados e lançados no mercado local de acordo com os requisitos atuais de Boas Práticas de Fabricação, Padrões Globais da Sanofi e Dossiês Regulatórios, enquanto aproveita inúmeras oportunidades para aumentar a sua experiência e aperfeiçoar as suas competências.

  • Colaborar com os gestores de departamento para identificar as necessidades de treinamento e desenvolver planos de treinamento personalizados

  • Manter o conhecimento e cumprir com os princípios de Ética e Integridade, políticas da Sanofi e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico
  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi, com objetivo de prevenir ocorrência de acidentes, evitar riscos para a saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir os impactos ambientais resultantes da execução de atividades do trabalho
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade e Inclusão da Sanofi para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais

Sobre você

  • Capacidade de criar programas e materiais de treinamento eficazes que atendam às necessidades da organização e cumpram os padrões regulatórios.
  • Proficiência na avaliação da eficácia do treinamento por meio de análise de dados, avaliações e feedback para melhorar continuamente os programas de treinamento.
  • Forte compreensão dos requisitos regulatórios e a capacidade de garantir que os programas de treinamento estejam alinhados com esses padrões.
  • Experiência em planejamento, organização e gerenciamento de projetos de treinamento, incluindo definição de cronogramas, alocação de recursos e monitoramento do progresso.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com a capacidade de transmitir informações de forma eficaz, colaborar com vários departamentos e apresentar resultados de treinamento à alta administração.
  • Formação acadêmica: Superior Completo em Farmácia
  • Línguas: Inglês Avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação)

Porque deve nos escolher?

  • Dê vida aos milagres da ciência ao lado de uma equipe solidária e orientada para o futuro.
  • Descubra inúmeras oportunidades para desenvolver o seu talento e impulsionar a sua carreira, quer seja através de uma promoção ou de uma mudança lateral, no seu país ou a nível internacional.

  • Cuide bem de você e da sua família, com uma vasta variedade de benefícios de saúde e bem-estar, incluindo cuidados de saúde de alta qualidade, programas de prevenção e bem-estar e, pelo menos, 14 semanas de licença parental sem distinção de gênero. Desempenhe um papel determinante na criação de melhores práticas na nossa unidade de fabricação.

Persiga o Progresso. Descubra o Extraordinário.

O progresso não seria possível sem as pessoas; pessoas de diferentes origens, em diferentes locais, desempenhando cargos diferentes, mas todas unidas por um objetivo comum: o desejo de fazer os milagres acontecerem. Você pode se tornar uma dessas pessoas. Procure a mudança, acolha novas ideias e explore todas as oportunidades que temos para oferecer. Persiga o progresso e descubra o extraordinário conosco.
